notes.title: Final patch with a new feature: quitting/resuming the game!
notes.content:
This is likely the last patch I'll make, unless a breaking bug is found!

Due to popular demand, I've implemented saving your game and resuming from the latest checkpoint! This should allow you to play quick sessions without fear of losing your progress. Hope that is useful for everyone.

All the best,
David

notes.title: Mouse sensitivity and Cloud save files!
notes.content: You should now be able to swap between devices and keep your save files! Also the mouse sensitivity slider is now working reliably.

notes.title: Chrono is a puzzler about time-controlling objects in the world
notes.content:
For fans of Portal and other first-person puzzle games, the indie game Chrono from Portuguese developer David Simoes is all about time-controlling objects across various rooms to progress.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/11/chrono-is-a-puzzler-about-time-controlling-objects-in-the-world

notes.title: Small QoL as requested by players!
notes.content: As requested by players, graphical QoL like WIndowed Mode, Field-of-View sliders, etc. Also small bugfixes and an experimental mouse sensitivity adjuster!

notes.title: Content Patch, 1.1
notes.content: All levels should now be tuned and complete. Only missing changes to Chrono are likely to be Quality-of-Life things, unless some big issue is reported!
